# ColdRunners

## Agents

- Master Planner — Orchestrates full autonomous workflow
- Google Places Discovery — Compliant geospatial business search
- Website Intelligence — Firecrawl scraping, Lighthouse audit, tech detection
- Contact Discovery — Hunter.io + Apollo.io email/contact enrichment
- Opportunity Scorer — 0-100 lead scoring with HOT/WARM/COLD classification
- Duplicate Detector — Multi-field deduplication

## MCP Tools

- discover_businesses — Full autonomous workflow
- analyze_website — Website performance and SEO analysis
- discover_contacts — Email and social profile discovery
- run_pagespeed — Google PageSpeed Insights
- get_leads — Retrieve stored leads with filtering
- export_leads — Export to CSV, JSON, Markdown, Excel
- get_stats — Platform statistics
- geocode_location — Address to coordinates
- check_plugin_health — Plugin health status

## Tech Stack

- TypeScript, Express, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Google Gemini API (with Ollama local LLM planned)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Google Places API, Firecrawl, Hunter.io, Apollo.io
- In-memory database (PostgreSQL + Qdrant planned)
